channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Once rare in Nevada, winter bald eagle sightings now common
item.description: Bald eagles are one of the rarest nesting raptors in the state, but they flock to the state for winter feeding. An annual winter count in Tahoe monitors those numbers, reflecting broader state and national populations.

item.title: OPINION: America’s runaway sports betting obsession ensures that ‘Everybody Loses’
item.description: It’s a story that includes strict sports gambling prohibitionists who later give thumbs-up to a league’s full embrace of the betting bonanza.

item.title: Pro-Lombardo PAC launches major ad campaign against top Democratic contender Aaron Ford
item.description: The seven-figure spending underscores Republicans’ belief that Ford’s time spent out of state is a vulnerability.

item.title: Will Nevada students face consequences for protesting ICE?
item.description: Many Nevada students have walked out of class in response to the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement operations.

item.title: Antes escasos en Nevada, avistamientos de águilas calvas en invierno ahora son comunes
item.description: Las águilas calvas son una de las aves rapaces anidadoras más raras de Nevada, pero acuden en bandadas para alimentarse durante el invierno. Un conteo anual de esta temporada en Tahoe refleja poblaciones estatales y nacionales más grandes.

item.title: OPINION: Remind me again why we still elect judges?
item.description: Nevadans deserve a fair and impartial judicial branch, one that reflects Alexander Hamilton’s dictum that it should possess judgment, not will. The way to get closer to this goal is to stop electing justices and instead carefully select them according to merit.

item.title: Nevada payday lending ballot initiative won’t return in 2026
item.description: The 2024 ballot initiative to crack down on high-interest lending in Nevada won’t be resurrected this year despite initial plans to do so, according to an official for the group behind the initiative.

item.title: ¿Los estudiantes de Nevada enfrentarán consecuencias por protestar contra ICE?
item.description: Muchos estudiantes de Nevada han salido de sus clases a manera de protesta por las operaciones de control migratorio de la administración Trump.

item.title: Nevada sportsbooks see lowest Super Bowl betting in a decade. Prediction markets to blame?
item.description: Despite the nearly 12 percent year-over-year drop in wagers as Kalshi and other platforms took bets, sportsbooks won almost $10 million.

item.title: Nevada hit with $447K fine for continued delays in mental health care for defendants
item.description: Defendants deemed unfit for trial are supposed to be transferred to a mental health facility within seven days of a court order, but the state has consistently failed to meet this deadline amid a shortage of mental health facilities.
